title: Quantify CFR teacher versus live topology coverage
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The preserved compact CFR teacher fails as a policy because its fixed SRP topology and state-support distribution cover only a minority of consequential live Slumbot decisions; explicit coverage metrics will identify the highest-value missing training topologies.
material_change: Add a reproducible learned-policy data coverage auditor comparing compact CFR rows with fresh Slumbot decision states across preflop topology, position, street, facing-bet, legal mask, action-history shape, pot and SPR.
baseline: CFR96 fresh501 -314.71 bb/100 CI95 [-544.84,-84.59], with severe 3-bet and river-showdown losses.

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: Targeted coverage tests pass (3/3); experiment-log tests also passed earlier in the turn.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: Across 994,208 teacher rows and 928 live postflop decisions, topology/history coverage was about 72%, pot/SPR coverage 45%, but exact history plus legal-action support only 1.5%.
result.conclusion: The retained teacher is structurally mismatched to deployment: it omits limp/3bet/4bet topologies and mostly exposes fold/call-only masks while live v55 commonly exposes the full raise grid. Training another adapter on the same data is not justified.
result.next_step: Build a small end-to-end solver-to-compact-data smoke using the deployed nine-slot action abstraction and at least SRP plus 3bet topologies; validate mask/history parity before scaling board count or training.
